name: City of Brass
oracle_text:
Whenever this land becomes tapped, it deals 1 damage to you.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
blocked_sentences: Whenever this land becomes tapped, it deals 1 damage to you.

needs.what: a trigger event fired whenever a permanent becomes tapped, for any reason -- paying a tap cost, attacking, or being tapped by another effect -- with the tapped permanent as the source so it can deal the damage
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has becomes_untapped but no tapped counterpart, so the exact inverse is simply absent. ability_activated is the nearest reachable substitute and is wrong twice over: it fires on activation of the mana ability rather than on the tap itself, so it would miss every other way the land becomes tapped (attacking, Sunken Ruins-style outside taps) and would still fire on a hypothetical untapped-cost ability that never taps.
